newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish futop turnover rises 60 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Danish futop turnover rises 60 pct in March.

text.p: Futures and options turnover on Denmark's Futop Exchange rose 60 percent in March to an average 5,157 contracts per day, the exchange said on Thursday.
It said the total turnover for March was 92,834 contracts compared to 64,648 in February.
At the same time trade in Danish state bonds rose 108 percent to 2,445 contracts per day, with total bond-based contracts 127 per cent up at 2,925, it said.
Equity-based contracts rose 15 percent to a daily 2,232 or 40,176 contracts for the whole month of March. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
